ex: 这里的饭菜太单一了。
The food here is too monotonous.
我们不能只靠单一的产品。
We can't rely on a single product.
这部电影是根据小说改编的。
This film was adapted from a novel.
他把这首歌改编成了钢琴曲。
He arranged the song for piano.
我们反对暴力。
We oppose violence.
这部电影暴力镜头太多了。
This film has too many violent scenes.
厨房的管道坏了。
The kitchen pipe is broken.
我们要多建立沟通管道。
We need to set up more channels of communication.
use: Measure word 条 or 根.

ex: 他兼任公司的财务经理。
He also serves as the company's finance manager.
校长兼任我们班的语文老师。
The headmaster also teaches our class Chinese.
爷爷有很多勋章。
Grandpa has many medals.
国家给他颁发了一枚勋章。
The state awarded him a medal.
use: Measure word 枚. Compare 奖牌 (sports medal).

ex: 这个车轮是合金的。
This wheel is made of alloy.
铝合金又轻又结实。
Aluminium alloy is light and strong.
那里发生过一起惨案。
A massacre once took place there.
人们永远不会忘记这次惨案。
People will never forget this tragedy.
他把所得的钱都给了父母。
He gave all the money he earned to his parents.
你要为个人所得交税。
You must pay tax on your personal income.
寺里住着几位僧人。
A few monks live in the temple.
那个僧人每天早上念经。
That monk chants sutras every morning.
这张桌子是圆形的。
This table is round.
广场中间有一个圆形的水池。
There's a round pool in the middle of the square.
use: 方形 = square; 三角形 = triangle.

ex: 他向我挥手。
He waved at me.
火车开了，她一直挥手告别。
As the train pulled out, she kept waving goodbye.
use: 挥手告别 = wave goodbye. Pattern: 向…挥手.

m: **Put** it down and **open** your grip: to **let go**.
ex: 放开我！
Let go of me!
你要放开心情，别想太多。
Relax and don't overthink it.
use: Also "open up" in policy: 放开价格.

ex: 月光很美。
The moonlight is beautiful.
我们在月光下散步。
We took a walk in the moonlight.
use: Slang 月光族 = people who spend all their pay each month.

ex: 他们用机枪射击。
They fired with machine guns.
远处传来一阵机枪声。
A burst of machine-gun fire came from the distance.

m: **Heaven**'s **storehouse**: the **Land of Abundance**, a name for Sichuan.
ex: 四川被称为天府之国。
Sichuan is called the Land of Abundance.
成都是天府之国的中心。
Chengdu is the heart of the Land of Abundance.
我们去海边度假吧。
Let's go to the seaside for a holiday.
他们一家正在三亚度假。
Their family is on holiday in Sanya.
这里曾经是殖民地。
This place was once a colony.
殖民时期留下了很多老建筑。
The colonial period left behind many old buildings.
我们在监测空气质量。
We are monitoring air quality.
这个手表可以监测心跳。
This watch can monitor your heart rate.
这个班有二十个学员。
This class has twenty trainees.
驾校的学员每天都要练车。
The driving school students practise every day.
use: For training courses; school pupils are 学生.

ex: 他们攻占了这座城市。
They captured this city.
这个品牌很快攻占了年轻人市场。
This brand quickly conquered the youth market.
印尼有很多岛屿。
Indonesia has many islands.
我去过印尼的巴厘岛。
I've been to Bali in Indonesia.
这是一座新建的医院。
This is a newly built hospital.
学校今年新建了一个图书馆。
The school built a new library this year.

m: **Turn over** your **body**: to **turn over**; to **break free**.
ex: 他在床上翻身，睡不着。
He tossed and turned in bed, unable to sleep.
农民们终于翻身做了主人。
The farmers finally stood up and became their own masters.

m: **Enjoin** and **instruct**: to **tell** (someone to do), to urge.
ex: 妈妈嘱咐我多穿衣服。
Mum told me to wear more clothes.
医生嘱咐他按时吃药。
The doctor told him to take his medicine on time.
use: Caring instructions, often from elders. Neutral tone: zhǔ fu.

ex: 这是他的新招数。
This is his new trick.
骗子的招数越来越多了。
Scammers have more and more tricks.
这里是孩子们的乐园。
This is a children's paradise.
周末我们去了海洋乐园。
At the weekend we went to an ocean park.
他年轻时当过民兵。
He was in the militia when he was young.
民兵们帮助村民抗洪。
The militia helped the villagers fight the flood.
股票价格波动很大。
Share prices fluctuate a lot.
她最近情绪波动很大。
Her mood has been up and down a lot lately.
他做了肝脏移植手术。
He had a liver transplant.
我们把这棵树移植到了院子里。
We transplanted the tree into the yard.
没有人能剥夺你的权利。
No one can take away your rights.
他被剥夺了比赛资格。
He was stripped of his eligibility to compete.
use: Formal; objects: 权利, 自由, 资格.

ex: 他轻轻叹息了一声。
He let out a soft sigh.
听到这个消息，大家都叹息不已。
Everyone sighed on hearing the news.

m: The **colour** of the **sky**: the time of day, how light or dark it is.
ex: 天色已经晚了。
It's getting late.
天色越来越暗，我们快回家吧。
It's getting darker; let's hurry home.
use: 天色晚了/暗了 = it's getting dark.

ex: 在我心目中，他是英雄。
In my eyes, he is a hero.
她在大家心目中是个好老师。
In everyone's mind she's a good teacher.
把鸡蛋放入锅中。
Put the eggs into the pot.
请把卡放入机器里。
Please insert the card into the machine.
运动能增强机体的抵抗力。
Exercise boosts the body's resistance.
飞机的机体没有受损。
The plane's body wasn't damaged.
她总是跟着潮流走。
She always follows the trends.
这是时代的潮流。
This is the trend of the times.
杯子被热水烫变形了。
The cup was warped by the hot water.
这个玩具可以变形成汽车。
This toy can transform into a car.
室内禁止吸烟。
Smoking is not allowed indoors.
下雨天我们只能在室内玩。
On rainy days we can only play indoors.
维吾尔族主要住在新疆。
The Uyghurs mainly live in Xinjiang.
她是维吾尔族人，会说维吾尔语。
She's Uyghur and speaks Uyghur.
自此以后，他再也没来过。
Since then, he has never come back.
两人自此成了好朋友。
From then on the two became good friends.
她很有魅力。
She's very charming.
这个城市有一种特别的魅力。
This city has a special charm.
钥匙在我口袋里。
The keys are in my pocket.
他从口袋里拿出一张照片。
He took a photo out of his pocket.
这个盒子是塑料的。
This box is plastic.
我们应该少用塑料袋。
We should use fewer plastic bags.
他们是多年的战友。
They've been comrades-in-arms for years.
爷爷常常想起以前的战友。
Grandpa often thinks of his old army comrades.
use: Also people who fought for the same cause.

ex: 她走路的姿态很优美。
She walks gracefully.
我们应该以积极的姿态面对困难。
We should face difficulties with a positive attitude.

m: The **Han** (river) **middle**: **Hanzhong**, a city in Shaanxi, a name.
ex: 汉中在陕西南部。
Hanzhong is in southern Shaanxi.
汉中的面皮很好吃。
Hanzhong's cold rice noodles are delicious.
use: Gave its name to the Han dynasty.

ex: 壮族是中国人口最多的少数民族。
The Zhuang are China's largest ethnic minority.
很多壮族人住在广西。
Many Zhuang people live in Guangxi.
他穿着一件灰色的外套。
He's wearing a grey coat.
今天的天空是灰色的。
The sky is grey today.
use: Also gloomy: 灰色的心情. 灰色收入 = grey income.

ex: 那家公司破产了。
That company went bankrupt.
他的计划最后破产了。
His plan fell through in the end.
舞台上的灯光不停变换。
The stage lights keep changing.
我们变换一下方法试试。
Let's try a different method.
我喜欢在网上购物。
I like shopping online.
周末商场里购物的人很多。
There are lots of shoppers in the mall at weekends.
use: 购物中心 = shopping centre. Spoken: 买东西.

m: **One** **circuit** of days: **one week**; a full circle.
ex: 我一周去三次健身房。
I go to the gym three times a week.
他绕着操场跑了一周。
He ran one lap round the sports ground.
敌人围攻了这座城。
The enemy besieged the city.
他在网上被很多人围攻。
He was attacked by lots of people online.
太阳是一颗恒星。
The sun is a star.
夜空中有无数颗恒星。
There are countless stars in the night sky.
use: 行星 = planet; 卫星 = satellite.

ex: 新工厂明年投产。
The new factory goes into production next year.
这条生产线已经正式投产。
This production line has officially started operating.
手机在振动。
The phone is vibrating.
汽车开过去，窗户都振动了。
When the truck went past, the windows shook.
use: 振动模式 = vibrate mode. Compare 震动 (shake, quake).

ex: 你这样说未免太早了。
It's a bit too early for you to say that.
这个价格未免太贵了吧。
This price is really rather expensive.
我们在沙滩上玩。
We're playing on the beach.
孩子们在沙滩上堆沙子。
The children are building sandcastles on the beach.

m: A **gap** and a **pitfall**: a **defect**, a flaw.
ex: 这个产品有缺陷。
This product is defective.
每个人都有自己的缺陷。
Everyone has their flaws.
她是个美女。
She's a beauty.
美女，请问地铁站怎么走？
Excuse me, miss, how do I get to the subway station?
use: Also a casual way to address a young woman.

ex: 他们明天北上北京。
They're heading north to Beijing tomorrow.
很多南方人北上找工作。
Many southerners go north to find work.
他很有学问。
He's very learned.
做饭也是一门学问。
Cooking is an art in itself.
use: 有学问 = learned. Measure word 门.

m: **Examine** to the **core**: to **review**, to **check and approve**.
ex: 你的申请正在审核中。
Your application is under review.
所有文章发表前都要审核。
All articles must be checked before publication.
大家都拥护这个决定。
Everyone supports this decision.
这位领导受到了人民的拥护。
This leader is supported by the people.
她会弹钢琴。
She can play the piano.
我女儿每周上一次钢琴课。
My daughter has a piano lesson once a week.
use: Verb: 弹. Measure word 架 or 台.

ex: 今天我来做饭。
I'll cook today.
他做饭做得很好吃。
He cooks really well.
你能来帮忙吗？
Can you come and help?
谢谢你帮忙，我自己搬不动。
Thanks for helping, I couldn't move it myself.
use: Separable: 帮我个忙, 帮了很大的忙. Cannot take an object; use 帮 + person.

ex: 他是惟一的证人。
He is the only witness.
这是惟一的办法。
This is the only way.
use: Old variant; today usually 唯一.

ex: 这种植物有药用价值。
This plant has medicinal value.
人参是一种药用植物。
Ginseng is a medicinal plant.
经济趋向稳定。
The economy is stabilising.
这是一种新的趋向。
This is a new trend.
use: Formal; 趋势 is more common for trend.

ex: 牙疼真折磨人。
Toothache really torments you.
这种病让他受尽了折磨。
This illness put him through great suffering.
这是纯粹的巧合。
This is pure coincidence.
他这样做纯粹是为了钱。
He does it purely for the money.
这只小猫真可爱！
This kitten is so cute!
她的女儿又聪明又可爱。
Her daughter is clever and cute.
use: Very common for children and animals.

ex: 给我一点提示吧。
Give me a hint.
手机提示电量不足。
The phone shows a low-battery warning.
use: 温馨提示 = friendly reminder (on signs).

ex: 他在看纽约时报。
He's reading the New York Times.
《环球时报》每天都有国际新闻。
The Global Times has international news every day.
我们学校有两个校区。
Our school has two campuses.
新校区离市中心比较远。
The new campus is quite far from the city centre.
他的作品获奖了。
His work won an award.
获奖的同学请上台。
Will the award winners please come on stage.
use: Separable: 获了奖. 获奖者 = winner.

ex: 我现在远程办公。
I work remotely now.
学生们在家上远程课程。
Students take online courses from home.
哈尔滨的冬天特别冷。
Winters in Harbin are especially cold.
我们一月去哈尔滨看冰灯。
In January we're going to Harbin to see the ice lanterns.
我很后悔没去。
I really regret not going.
你现在不努力，以后会后悔的。
If you don't work hard now, you'll regret it later.
use: For your own actions; 遗憾 is more about circumstances.

ex: 飞机已经抵达上海。
The plane has arrived in Shanghai.
代表团将于明天抵达北京。
The delegation will arrive in Beijing tomorrow.
这个消息让大家很受鼓舞。
Everyone was heartened by the news.
他的成功鼓舞了很多年轻人。
His success inspired many young people.
他不时看看手表。
He glances at his watch now and then.
窗外不时传来汽车声。
The sound of cars came from outside now and then.
我在路上遇上了老同学。
I ran into an old classmate on the street.
回家的路上遇上了大雨。
I got caught in heavy rain on the way home.
use: Spoken; close to 遇到 and 碰上.

ex: 这是大学附属医院。
This is a university-affiliated hospital.
他上的是师大附属中学。
He attends the high school attached to the teachers' university.
use: 附属中学 = 附中 (affiliated school).

ex: 他被驱逐出境。
He was deported.
政府驱逐了两名外交官。
The government expelled two diplomats.
他否认偷了钱。
He denied stealing the money.
这一点谁也不能否认。
Nobody can deny this point.
记者问了一个尖锐的问题。
The reporter asked a pointed question.
他的批评很尖锐。
His criticism is very sharp.

m: A **courtyard** for **science** (**branch of study**, **learning**): an **academy of sciences**.
ex: 他在科学院工作。
He works at the Academy of Sciences.
中国科学院在北京。
The Chinese Academy of Sciences is in Beijing.
use: 中科院 is the short form.

ex: 他是一个美国黑人歌手。
He is an African American singer.
这部电影讲的是一位黑人运动员的故事。
This film tells the story of a black athlete.
use: Neutral descriptive word; formal writing may use 非洲裔 (of African descent).

ex: 他的话不尽是真的。
Not everything he said is true.
我对你的帮助感激不尽。
I can't thank you enough for your help.
这两条线是平行的。
These two lines are parallel.
两条马路平行，中间是公园。
The two roads run parallel with a park in between.
敌军已经撤退了。
The enemy troops have retreated.
我们包围了敌军。
We surrounded the enemy forces.
这是二次检查。
This is a second inspection.
他在比赛中受了二次伤。
He was injured a second time in the match.
我们之间有分歧。
We have differences.
双方在价格上存在分歧。
The two sides disagree on price.
use: 意见分歧 = difference of opinion.

ex: 他总是回避这个问题。
He always dodges this question.
你不能一直回避现实。
You can't avoid reality forever.
他对天文很感兴趣。
He's very interested in astronomy.
这是一个天文数字。
That's an astronomical figure.
use: 天文学 = astronomy; 天文台 = observatory.

ex: 我每周去一次超市。
I go to the supermarket once a week.
每周五下午我们开会。
We have a meeting every Friday afternoon.
这种茶的产地是云南。
This tea comes from Yunnan.
买东西的时候要看清产地。
Check where things are made when you shop.
他累得疲惫不堪。
He was utterly exhausted.
这条路破旧不堪，很难走。
This road is in terrible shape and hard to walk on.
use: After negative words: 不堪一击 (can't take a hit), 痛苦不堪.

ex: 这真是一个奇迹！
This is truly a miracle!
医生说他能活下来是个奇迹。
The doctors said his survival was a miracle.
use: 创造奇迹 = work a miracle.

ex: 你用的是哪家运营商？
Which carrier do you use?
三大运营商都降价了。
All three big mobile carriers cut prices.
马克思是德国人。
Marx was German.
他读过马克思的很多书。
He has read many of Marx's books.
他的动机是什么？
What's his motive?
学习动机对孩子很重要。
Motivation to learn is very important for children.
消息很快扩散了。
The news spread quickly.
医生说病毒还没有扩散。
The doctor says the virus hasn't spread yet.
山上有很多鹧鸪。
There are lots of partridges on the hill.
树林里传来鹧鸪的叫声。
The call of partridges came from the woods.
use: Measure word 只. Often in poems.

ex: 他不止一次说过这话。
He has said this more than once.
孩子大哭不止。
The child cried and cried.
孔子是儒家的创始人。
Confucius founded Confucianism.
儒家思想对中国影响很深。
Confucian thought has deeply influenced China.
use: 家 = school of thought: 道家, 法家.

m: **Fill** the role and **be**: to **serve as**, to **act as**.
ex: 他充当翻译。
He's acting as interpreter.
这间小屋充当了临时教室。
This hut served as a makeshift classroom.
他是公认的好老师。
He is widely recognised as a good teacher.
这个说法已经得到了公认。
This view has been generally accepted.
他是工会主席。
He is chairman of the union.
工会为员工组织了一次旅游。
The union organised a trip for the staff.
她在师范大学读书。
She studies at a teachers' university.
他是师范毕业的。
He graduated from teacher training.
use: 北京师范大学 = Beijing Normal University.

ex: 他狠狠地打了一下桌子。
He banged the table hard.
妈妈狠狠地批评了他一顿。
Mum gave him a severe telling-off.
我想知道真相。
I want to know the truth.
警察终于查出了事情的真相。
The police finally found out the truth.
use: 真相大白 = the truth comes out.

ex: 老师给我们示范了一遍。
The teacher demonstrated it for us once.
这是一个示范学校。
This is a model school.
请把护照连同表格交给我。
Please give me your passport together with the form.
他连同家人一起搬到了上海。
He moved to Shanghai along with his family.
房价开始下跌了。
House prices have begun to fall.
今天股市下跌了百分之三。
The stock market fell 3% today.
use: Prices and numbers. Opposite: 上涨.

ex: 这座楼建于十九世纪末。
This building was built at the end of the 19th century.
上个世纪末，手机开始流行起来。
At the end of the last century, mobile phones started to catch on.
黄山在安徽省。
Huangshan is in Anhui Province.
安徽省的省会是合肥。
The capital of Anhui Province is Hefei.
我没法帮你。
I can't help you.
雨太大了，没法出门。
It's raining too hard to go out.
他在监狱里待了十年。
He spent ten years in prison.
这座监狱已经关闭了。
This prison has been closed.
这条航道很繁忙。
This shipping lane is very busy.
冬天这段航道会结冰。
This stretch of waterway freezes in winter.
你的电话号码是多少？
What's your phone number?
我记错了房间号码。
I remembered the wrong room number.
use: 电话号码, 手机号码.

ex: 我家在河的南岸。
My home is on the south bank of the river.
长江南岸有很多工厂。
There are many factories on the south bank of the Yangtze.
请写下你的名字。
Please write down your name.
他在日记里写下了那天的事。
He wrote down that day's events in his diary.
军队开始撤退。
The army began to retreat.
大火来了，大家赶快撤退！
The fire's coming, everyone get out quickly!
这是一座王家花园。
This is a royal garden.
他在王家音乐学院学习。
He studies at the Royal Academy of Music.
use: Also the surname 王 + family: the Wangs.

ex: 路上的行人很少。
There are few people on the street.
开车的时候要让行人先走。
When driving, let pedestrians go first.
我们都知道健康的重要性。
We all know how important health is.
他还没认识到问题的重要性。
He hasn't realised the importance of the problem yet.
use: 性 = -ness: 可能性, 必要性.

m: Be the **owner** who **handles** it: to **host**, to **organise**.
ex: 这次会议由我们公司主办。
Our company is hosting this conference.
北京主办过两次奥运会。
Beijing has hosted the Olympics twice.
你先忙，我的事不要紧。
You carry on; my thing isn't urgent.
他的病要紧吗？
Is his illness serious?
我订了一本周刊。
I subscribe to a weekly magazine.
这期周刊有一篇很好的文章。
This issue of the weekly has a good article.

m: **Go in** and **go out**: to **come and go**.
ex: 这里不许随便进出。
You can't come and go freely here.
每天有很多人进出这栋大楼。
Many people go in and out of this building every day.
他兀自站在那里。
He was still standing there.
天已经黑了，她兀自不肯回家。
It was already dark, yet she still wouldn't go home.
他厉声说：“站住！”
He shouted sternly, "Stop!"
老师厉声批评了那个学生。
The teacher sharply criticised that student.
这里保安很严密。
Security here is very tight.
他的计划非常严密。
His plan is very thorough.
届时请准时参加。
Please attend on time at that time.
会议下周举行，届时将有很多专家参加。
The meeting is next week, when many experts will attend.
我们要提请政府注意这个问题。
We should bring this issue to the government's attention.
这个问题将提请大会讨论。
This issue will be submitted to the assembly for discussion.
山下有一个小村庄。
There's a small village at the foot of the hill.
这个村庄只有几十户人家。
This village has only a few dozen households.
use: Measure word 座 or 个.

ex: 他相貌很普通。
He looks very ordinary.
不要只看一个人的相貌。
Don't judge people only by their looks.
新路缩短了时间。
The new road shortened the journey.
我们要缩短和别人的差距。
We need to close the gap with others.
你万万不能告诉他。
You absolutely must not tell him.
我万万没想到会遇见你。
I never in a million years expected to meet you.
use: Mostly before negatives: 万万不可.

ex: 墙壁上挂着一幅画。
A painting hangs on the wall.
我们把墙壁刷成了白色。
We painted the walls white.
这个手机套餐资费很低。
This phone plan's charges are very low.
国际漫游资费比较贵。
International roaming charges are rather expensive.
学校九月开学。
School starts in September.
九月的天气不冷也不热。
The weather in September is neither cold nor hot.
她揭开了锅盖。
She lifted the lid off the pot.
科学家揭开了这个秘密。
Scientists uncovered this secret.
use: 揭开序幕 = raise the curtain on.

ex: 他的儿女都在国外。
His children are all abroad.
父母总是为儿女着想。
Parents always think of their children.
use: 儿女情长 = tender feelings between lovers.

ex: 他是驻英国公使。
He is the minister to Britain.
公使到外交部见了部长。
The envoy met the minister at the foreign ministry.
我们挥手告别。
We waved goodbye.
他向朋友们告别，然后上了火车。
He said goodbye to his friends and got on the train.
use: 向…告别; 告别仪式 = farewell ceremony.

ex: 她是个很聪明的女孩子。
She's a very clever girl.
班里的女孩子都喜欢跳舞。
The girls in the class all like dancing.
安娜是我的同学。
Anna is my classmate.
安娜来中国学习汉语。
Anna came to China to study Chinese.
这个项目还在审批。
This project is still awaiting approval.
申请需要三个部门审批。
The application needs approval from three departments.
use: Official procedure. 审批手续 = approval process.

m: Reach in with a **stick** in **advance**: to **intervene**, to meddle.
ex: 父母不应该干预孩子的婚姻。
Parents shouldn't meddle in their children's marriages.
政府对市场进行了干预。
The government intervened in the market.
这趟火车直达上海。
This train goes straight to Shanghai.
有没有去机场的直达车？
Is there a direct bus to the airport?
他因为作弊受到了处分。
He was disciplined for cheating.
学校给了他一个警告处分。
The school gave him a formal warning.
use: School and workplace discipline. Note 处 is chǔ.

ex: 娘娘，皇上来了。
Your Majesty, the emperor is here.
庙里供着送子娘娘。
The temple honours the goddess who grants children.
use: Period-drama word. Neutral tone: niáng niang.

ex: 这件陶器是汉代的。
This pottery is from the Han dynasty.
汉代的丝绸之路很有名。
The Silk Road of the Han dynasty is famous.

m: The **foot of a hill** of the **mountain**: the **foothills**.
ex: 村子在山麓下。
The village sits in the foothills.
我们在山麓找到了一家小旅馆。
We found a small inn at the foot of the mountain.
他想保全自己的名声。
He wants to protect his reputation.
这些文物终于被保全下来了。
These relics were finally preserved.
use: Formal; 保全面子 = save face.

m: **Pass on** and go **out**: to **spread out**, to come from.
ex: 屋里传出歌声。
Singing came from inside the house.
公司要裁员的消息很快传出去了。
News that the company would cut jobs got out quickly.

m: **Half** the **night**: **midnight**, the middle of the night.
ex: 他半夜才回家。
He didn't get home until midnight.
半夜里突然下起了大雨。
It suddenly started pouring in the middle of the night.
use: 三更半夜 = dead of night.

ex: 男生多于女生。
There are more boys than girls.
今年的收入多于支出。
This year's income exceeds spending.
春季气候很好。
The spring weather is lovely.
学校每年春季开运动会。
The school holds a sports day every spring.
图上有一条曲线。
There's a curve on the graph.
她的身体曲线很美。
She has a beautiful figure.
use: 曲线图 = line graph. Opposite: 直线.

m: **Open** the **door**: to **open the door**; to **open** for business.
ex: 有人敲门，快去开门。
Someone's knocking, go and open the door.
银行早上九点开门。
The bank opens at nine in the morning.
use: Separable: 开了门. Opposite: 关门.

ex: 他借助字典看懂了这篇文章。
He understood the article with the help of a dictionary.
我们可以借助网络学习外语。
We can use the internet to learn foreign languages.
use: Formal; 借助于 is also used.

ex: 路的两旁种着很多树。
Lots of trees are planted on both sides of the road.
街道两旁都是商店。
Shops line both sides of the street.
use: After a noun: 路两旁, 街道两旁.

ex: 她的公公对她很好。
Her father-in-law is very good to her.
电视剧里的公公是皇帝身边的人。
The eunuch in the TV drama is one of the emperor's attendants.
use: Husband's father. Wife's father: 岳父.

ex: 他有慢性胃病。
He has a chronic stomach problem.
慢性病需要长期治疗。
Chronic illnesses need long-term treatment.
use: Opposite: 急性 (acute). Also 慢性子 (slowcoach).

ex: 记者进入了战区。
The journalist went into the war zone.
很多人逃离了战区。
Many people fled the war zone.
孩子喜欢模仿大人。
Children like to imitate adults.
他模仿老师说话，大家都笑了。
He imitated the teacher's voice and everyone laughed.
农业部发布了新规定。
The Ministry of Agriculture issued new rules.
他在农业部工作了二十年。
He worked at the Ministry of Agriculture for twenty years.

m: The **face** of a **picture**: a **scene**, an **image** on screen.
ex: 这个画面很美。
This scene is beautiful.
电视突然没有画面了。
The TV suddenly lost the picture.
我们在公园西门见。
Let's meet at the west gate of the park.
学校西门对面有一家书店。
There's a bookshop opposite the school's west gate.
use: 西门庆 is a famous character with this surname.

ex: 他喜欢诸如画画、唱歌这样的活动。
He likes activities such as painting and singing.
诸如此类的问题还有很多。
There are many more problems like this.
use: Formal; 诸如此类 = and so on.

ex: 这座房子建于清末。
This house was built in the late Qing.
清末有很多人去国外留学。
In the late Qing many people went abroad to study.

m: The **liberation** (**untie** and **release**) **war** (**fight** and **strive**): the **War of Liberation**.
ex: 解放战争在一九四九年结束。
The War of Liberation ended in 1949.
他的爷爷参加过解放战争。
His grandfather fought in the War of Liberation.

m: **Going in** and **going out** of the **mouth**: **import and export**; entrance and exit.
ex: 他做进出口生意。
He's in the import-export business.
今年中国的进出口增长了很多。
China's imports and exports grew a lot this year.
第一轮比赛我们赢了。
We won the first round.
新一轮谈判下周开始。
A new round of talks starts next week.
use: Also 一轮明月 (a round bright moon).

ex: 这个词来源于英语。
This word comes from English.
他的灵感来源于生活。
His inspiration comes from daily life.

m: Two **hey** sounds: **heh heh**, a sly laugh.
ex: 嘿嘿，我知道你的秘密。
Heh heh, I know your secret.
他不好意思地嘿嘿笑了两声。
He gave an embarrassed little chuckle.
use: Online and spoken; shy or cheeky laugh.

ex: 他是个富人。
He's a rich man.
这个地区住着很多富人。
Many rich people live in this area.
昨晚我很早就睡了。
I went to bed early last night.
你昨晚看那场球赛了吗？
Did you watch the match last night?
不知什么缘故，他没来。
For some reason, he didn't come.
因为下雨的缘故，比赛推迟了。
Because of the rain, the match was postponed.
她在一所中学任教。
She teaches at a secondary school.
他在北京大学任教二十年了。
He has taught at Peking University for twenty years.
use: Formal; speech: 当老师, 教书.

ex: 你会游泳吗？
Can you swim?
夏天我每天都去游泳。
In summer I go swimming every day.
use: Separable: 游了一会儿泳. 游泳池 = pool.

ex: 几个部委联合发了通知。
Several ministries jointly issued a notice.
中央部委的领导来视察了。
Leaders from the central ministries came to inspect.
阿根廷在南美洲。
Argentina is in South America.
阿根廷的足球很厉害。
Argentina is great at football.
经济发展势头很好。
Economic growth has strong momentum.
看这个势头，明天还会下雨。
By the look of things, it will rain again tomorrow.
use: 看势头 = judging by how things are going.

ex: 改革的呼声越来越高。
Calls for reform are growing louder.
他是这次选举中呼声最高的人。
He's the favourite in this election.
别指望他会帮你。
Don't count on him to help you.
这件事已经没有指望了。
There's no hope for this any more.
今年降水比较少。
There's been rather little rain this year.
明天北方大部分地区有降水。
There will be rain or snow in most northern areas tomorrow.
use: Weather forecasts; note 降 is jiàng.

m: A **society** where land is **conferred** and **established**: **feudal society**.
ex: 中国的封建社会很长。
Chinese feudal society lasted a long time.
在封建社会，女人地位很低。
In feudal society, women had low status.
use: Also 封建思想 (feudal thinking, old-fashioned).

ex: 我买了一本旅游指南。
I bought a travel guide.
这是新生入学指南。
This is the guide for new students.
这是大家关注的焦点。
This is the focus of everyone's attention.
她一进门就成了焦点。
She became the centre of attention the moment she walked in.
他慢慢走近那只狗。
He slowly approached the dog.
我走近一看，原来是我的同学。
When I got closer, it turned out to be my classmate.
他是共产党员。
He is a Communist Party member.
他二十岁就成了共产党员。
He became a Communist Party member at twenty.

m: **Bent** under what's **entrusted** to you: **wronged**, hard done by.
ex: 她觉得很委屈，哭了起来。
She felt wronged and started crying.
让你受委屈了，对不起。
Sorry you had to put up with that.
use: 受委屈 = be treated unfairly. Neutral tone: wěi qu.

m: **Plum** (Li), **first**, **think**: **Li Xiannian**, a PRC leader, a name.
ex: 李先念是湖北人。
Li Xiannian was from Hubei.
李先念当过国家主席。
Li Xiannian served as President of China.
